BEACON HILL SCHOOL

BOYLE'S COURT,
SOUTH WEALD,
Nr. BRENTWOOD,
ESSEX.
April 18th 193

Dear Max Hedann,

I am sorry if I misunderstood your letter. I thought that you wrote that Frau Lindback could pay "nur" 2½ pounds a week. I have not got the letter here with me. As you will understand, it would be very difficult for me to carry on the school; if I took all children for very little. I do not mind doing it in this case, since it will not be over a long period. Please ask Frau Lindback to let us know if we are to expect Janka next term.

By address here is

Carn Veel
Porthcurno
Cornwall.

Yours sincerely,

Dr. Russell

BOYLE'S COURT,
SOUTH WEALD,
Near Brentwood,
Essex.
April 18th, 193 [Year]

Dear Mr. Hedann,

I am sorry if I have misunderstood your letter. I believed that Frau Lindback was able to pay £2½ per week. Unfortunately, the original letter is not with me. As you can appreciate, it would be exceedingly difficult for me to continue running the school, especially if I were to accept all children at a very low rate. However, given that this arrangement will only be temporary, I am willing to proceed. Please ask Frau Lindback to inform us whether Janka will be joining us next term.

My address is:

Carn Veel
Porthcurno
Cornwall.

Yours sincerely,

Dr. Russell
